2607.00605.title: Auditing Forgetting in Limited Memory Language Models
2607.00605.paper_summary: Limited Memory Language Models (LMLMs) externalize factual knowledge to a database to enable deletion-based unlearning without retraining. Existing evaluations measure post-deletion correctness in aggregate and cannot tell whether a deleted fact persists through residual parametric memory, alternative retrieval paths, or near-neighbor retrieval artifacts. We propose a causal auditing framework that holds the model fixed and varies the database state at inference time across three interventions: FULL, DEL-ON, and DEL-OFF. The framework decomposes post-deletion behavior into parametric leakage L(f), retrieval-mediated correctness R(f), and a retrieval artifact rate grounded in the inference-time retrieval trace. We apply it to 12,228 alias-closure deletions across thirteen databases, including four adversarial topologies (Base, Alias, Noise, Collision) we construct in three domains, and six prompt formulations. Parametric leakage is near zero in every variant and every prompt style: the model rarely returns the deleted answer in the absence of retrieval. The residual that does survive lives in the retrieval graph: retrieval-mediated correctness and the retrieval artifact rate match within rounding everywhere, so post-deletion correctness is, in our audit, predominantly reconstituted from near-neighbor retrieval. This residual ranges from 0.7% on the released LMLM database to 13.6% on the most adversarial variant, and prompt formulation does not independently control how much of a deleted fact survives. These results suggest that, for this class of LMLM and deletion procedure, the unlearning boundary is drawn primarily by the database administrator rather than by the model.
2607.00605.paper_summary_zh: 有限記憶語言模型（LMLMs）將事實知識外部化到數據庫中，以實現基於刪除的非學習，而無需重新訓練。現有的評估測量刪除後的正確性總體，無法判斷刪除的事實是否通過殘餘參數記憶、替代檢索路徑或近鄰檢索工件持續存在。我們提出了一個因果審計框架，該框架在推理時固定模型並變更數據庫狀態，進行三種干預：FULL、DEL-ON 和 DEL-OFF。該框架將刪除後的行為分解為參數洩漏 L(f)、檢索介導的正確性 R(f) 和基於推理時檢索痕跡的檢索工件率。我們將其應用於 12,228 個別名關閉刪除，涵蓋十三個數據庫，包括我們在三個領域構建的四種對抗拓撲（Base、Alias、Noise、Collision）和六種提示表達。每個變體和每種提示風格中的參數洩漏幾乎為零：在缺乏檢索的情況下，模型很少返回已刪除的答案。存活下來的殘餘存在於檢索圖中：檢索介導的正確性和檢索工件率在四捨五入時處處吻合，因此在我們的審計中，刪除後的正確性主要是從近鄰檢索中重新構建的。這些殘餘在釋放的 LMLM 數據庫上範圍從 0.7% 到在最具對抗性的變體上達到 13.6%，而提示表達並不獨立控制有多少已刪除的事實存活。這些結果表明，對於這類 LMLM 和刪除程序，非學習邊界主要由數據庫管理員而非模型來劃定。
2607.00605.author: Arya Raeesi et.al.
